From Earth Wind and Fire · Price: you turn into objects only, and you can't attack in object form.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 2 actions: become a Small object. You can't move or attack; Perception DC = your stand DC to spot you.
  • 5: Become a Medium object; you get resistance equal to your level while shaped.
  • 9: Surge: leave object form with a free Strike against an adjacent creature, which is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard}.
  • 13: Become a cart or small boat that up to four allies can ride; you move it at your Speed.
  • 17: Become a Large object.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.SEVLkSvCkR1OPJu8]{Effect: Object Form}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
